units.en: 7 Related Work
units.zh: 7 相关工作

units.en: Storage and flash simulators. MQSim [38] and SimpleSSD [15] model the flash medium together with the surrounding block device and host driver stack; both intercept at the host’s block device interface. HBFSim reuses the flash media model of MQSim and drives that media model in the opposite direction: the MQSim event queue is advanced on demand while the workload runs (Section 2). MQSim is therefore a component of HBFSim rather than a competitor: HBF-Sim charges the modeled time of a page read to one access made by a kernel that is executing on the GPU. HBFSim intercepts at the GPU’s instruction path, so the requests come from a workload that is executing. SwarmIO [19] emulates a drive that GPU threads read themselves, and meets the same conflict Challenge 2 states between a timing model that is accurate and the cost of evaluating that model at high request rates. The drive SwarmIO emulates is reached over NVMe submission queues and a PCIe link, so an emulator can act at a queue, a doorbell register or a replaceable driver layer. An HBF access is issued by the GPU’s own load/store units and is served inside the accelerator package, so the host side offers no queue, no doorbell register and no replaceable driver layer (Challenge 1).
units.zh: 存储与闪存模拟器。MQSim [38] 和 SimpleSSD [15] 将闪存介质与周围块设备及主机驱动栈一并建模；二者都在主机块设备接口处拦截。HBFSim 复用 MQSim 的闪存介质模型，并以相反方向驱动该模型：在工作负载运行时按需推进 MQSim 事件队列（第 2 节）。因此，MQSim 是 HBFSim 的组件，而非竞争者：HBFSim 将一次页读取的建模时间，计入正在 GPU 上执行的内核所发出的一次访问。HBFSim 在 GPU 指令路径上拦截，因此请求来自实际运行中的工作负载。SwarmIO [19] 仿真一个由 GPU 线程自行读取的驱动器，也面临挑战 2 中所述的矛盾：时序模型的准确性与高请求速率下模型求值成本之间的冲突。访问 SwarmIO 所仿真的驱动器需要经过 NVMe 提交队列和 PCIe 链路，因此仿真器可以在队列、门铃寄存器或可替换驱动层处介入。HBF 访问则由 GPU 自身加载/存储单元发出，在加速器封装内部获得服务，因此主机侧没有队列、门铃寄存器或可替换驱动层可供介入（挑战 1）。

units.en: GPU simulation and GPU instrumentation. GPGPU-Sim [3] and Accel-Sim [18] run a modeled GPU, not the GPU on which the system will be deployed. eGPU [43] places code inside a running GPU kernel and is the direct predecessor of the instrumentation route HBFSim uses; HBFSim applies that ability to the timing and the capacity behaviour of a device that does not exist yet.
units.zh: GPU 模拟与 GPU 插桩。GPGPU-Sim [3] 和 Accel-Sim [18] 运行的是建模的 GPU，而非系统最终部署所用的 GPU。eGPU [43] 把代码放入正在运行的 GPU 内核中，是 HBFSim 所用插桩路线的直接前身；HBFSim 将这种能力用于尚不存在器件的时序与容量行为。

units.en: Simulating a device that cannot be obtained. Three systems at other tiers simulate a device that cannot be obtained, and HBFSim differs from each on three axes. Cylon [45] emulates a CXL-attached solid-state drive presented as a byte-addressable memory tier, and acts on the CPU side through virtualization. CXLMemSim [42] simulates a pooled memory tier by attaching to an unmodified running program, observing memory accesses with hardware performance counters and kernel instrumentation, and injecting delay once per fixed interval of execution. FlashAccel [41] is a hardware–software co-design of an inference system built on HBF, evaluated with an event-driven simulator. The device HBFSim simulates is flash inside the accelerator package, read at 64 bytes and written at 4 KiB, with the wear and retention limits a DRAM pool does not have. Accesses are observed and delayed in rewritten intermediate code on the GPU, not at the virtual machine layer or in CPU performance counters. The third axis is the loop from temperature to reliability: none of the three makes temperature part of the device interface, whereas the HBF specification defines temperature as values the host reads, thresholds the host sets and states the host has to respond to. Temperature itself is not new to simulation: prior work extends architectural sampling to the thermal domain, because accurate estimation of thermal behaviour is itself time-consuming [2].
units.zh: 模拟无法获得的器件。在其他层级，有三个系统模拟无法获得的器件，HBFSim 与它们分别在三个维度上存在差异。Cylon [45] 仿真 CXL 连接的固态盘，将其呈现为可按字节寻址的内存层，并通过虚拟化在 CPU 侧介入。CXLMemSim [42] 附着于未经修改的运行中程序，使用硬件性能计数器与内核插桩观察内存访问，并在每个固定执行区间注入一次延迟，以模拟池化内存层。FlashAccel [41] 是基于 HBF 的推理系统软硬件协同设计，使用事件驱动模拟器评估。HBFSim 所模拟的是位于加速器封装内部的闪存，读取粒度为 64 字节，写入粒度为 4 KiB，并具有 DRAM 池没有的磨损与数据保持限制。访问是在 GPU 上重写后的中间代码中被观察和延迟，而非在虚拟机层或 CPU 性能计数器中处理。第三个维度是温度到可靠性的闭环：上述三个系统均未把温度作为器件接口的一部分，而 HBF 规范将温度定义为主机读取的数值、主机设置的阈值，以及主机必须响应的状态。温度本身并非模拟领域的新事物：已有工作将架构采样扩展到热领域，因为准确估计热行为本身也很耗时 [2]。

units.en: Full-system simulation before the silicon exists. A full-system simulator that already supports a new memory technology is the obvious alternative to HBFSim, and the history of HBM support in gem5 [5] shows what such support consists of while the parts are still unavailable. The HBM configurations added to gem5 in September 2015 are timing values fed to the ordinary DDR controller; the commit message gives “Timing extrapolated from existing LPDDR configurations” as one of three sources for those values, and adds, “Will adjust once specs become available.” A memory controller written for HBM itself, with pseudo channels, arrived only in May 2022, six years after HBM2 shipped with the P100. Before the silicon exists, the answer a full-system simulator gives is therefore itself extrapolated from a neighbouring standard.
units.zh: 芯片问世之前的全系统模拟。一个已经支持新内存技术的全系统模拟器，是 HBFSim 的显而易见的替代方案；gem5 [5] 对 HBM 的支持历史，展示了当器件尚不可得时，这种支持实际上由什么构成。2015 年 9 月加入 gem5 的 HBM 配置，是输入普通 DDR 控制器的时序值；提交说明将“由现有 LPDDR 配置外推时序”列为这些数值的三个来源之一，并补充“规范发布后将作调整”。真正为 HBM 编写、支持伪通道的内存控制器直到 2022 年 5 月才出现，距 HBM2 随 P100 出货已过六年。因此，在芯片问世之前，全系统模拟器给出的答案本身，也是从相近标准外推得到的。

units.en: 8 Discussion
units.zh: 8 讨论

units.en: The calibrated curve is measured on a complete host paging path, a software route that presents an NVMe solid-state drive as memory through the device node /dev/vmem0. One access along that route carries a page fault, the driver, page-cache insertion and a user-space scan, so the profile is named an end-to-end vmem model rather than a media model. The curve is fitted at 1, 4, 16, 64, 256 and 512 pages, and past 512 pages continues on the slope of the last measured segment. Random, reverse, repeated and cross-operation accesses reset the burst length to one and are charged the single-page cost of 11,133 ns, so the non-linear rise measured between 64 and 512 pages shapes sequential bursts alone.
units.zh: 校准曲线是在完整主机分页路径上测得的：这是一条通过设备节点 `/dev/vmem0` 将 NVMe 固态盘呈现为内存的软件路径。沿此路径的一次访问包含缺页、驱动处理、页缓存插入和用户态扫描，因此该配置被称为端到端 vmem 模型，而非介质模型。曲线在 1、4、16、64、256 和 512 页处拟合，超过 512 页后沿最后一个实测区段的斜率继续延伸。随机、反向、重复及跨操作访问，会将突发长度重置为 1，并计入单页成本 11,133 ns；因此，在 64–512 页间测得的非线性增长只影响顺序突发访问。

units.en: An HBF stack inside the package pays no page fault, no driver crossing and no page-cache insertion, and the second timing source is built for the difference: foreground requests enter an online MQSim media model on the host along the reference path. A question about the medium is therefore answered with the media model, and a question about a host-attached deployment with the calibrated end-to-end curve.
units.zh: 封装内部的 HBF 堆栈不承担缺页、跨驱动边界或页缓存插入成本，因此第二种时序源正是针对这一区别构建的：前台请求沿参考路径进入主机侧在线 MQSim 介质模型。因此，关于介质的问题由介质模型回答，关于主机连接部署的问题则由校准的端到端曲线回答。

units.en: Coverage is a property of each run rather than a fixed ceiling. Kernels that arrive already built are covered at the level of the whole program, where injected modeled time enters the end-to-end time and the output is unchanged. Results therefore carry to accesses inside registered ranges of rewritable kernels, and widening that set is a question of registration and of the rewriting layer, not of the timing model.
units.zh: 覆盖范围是每次运行自身的属性，而非固定上限。以预构建形式到达的内核，在整个程序层面被覆盖：注入的建模时间进入端到端耗时，而输出不变。因此，结果适用于可重写内核中已注册范围内的访问；扩大这一集合属于注册与重写层的问题，而非时序模型的问题。

units.en: Hardware parameters that move are data rather than code. The three synthetic timing profiles are conservative.json, nominal.json and aggressive.json; all three share a capacity of 1 TiB and differ in bandwidth, which ranges from 128 to 1,000 GB/s, while the published specification gives about 3.0 TB/s and 512 GB per stack [4], so re-anchoring the profiles to the published figures edits a data file. The thermal measurements come from one GPU and one Dell CD8P solid-state drive, since HBF parts cannot yet be obtained, and the simulated-warning profile crosses the configured GPU and SSD warning points at 30 s and 42 s by extrapolation, with no physical device taken there, so figures using that profile mark the two crossings as computed values. Retention deadlines follow the Arrhenius equation anchored on $E_a=1.04$ eV, measured for 3D NAND after 10,000 program/erase cycles [26]; a medium with a different activation energy moves every deadline and the refresh traffic each deadline forces, which is why a run reports a sweep over activation energy rather than one lifetime.
units.zh: 会变化的硬件参数以数据而非代码表示。三个合成时序配置为 `conservative.json`、`nominal.json` 和 `aggressive.json`；它们容量均为 1 TiB，带宽不同，范围为 128–1,000 GB/s，而公开规范给出每堆栈约 3.0 TB/s 和 512 GB [4]，因此，使配置重新对齐公开数值只需修改数据文件。由于尚无法获得 HBF 器件，热测量来自一块 GPU 和一块 Dell CD8P 固态盘；`simulated-warning` 配置通过外推，在 30 s 和 42 s 跨过所配置的 GPU 与 SSD 警告点，并未使任何物理器件真正达到这些状态，因此采用该配置的图会将两次越界标为计算值。数据保持期限遵循 Arrhenius 方程，其锚点激活能为 $E_a=1.04$ eV，来自经历 10,000 次编程/擦除循环后的 3D NAND 实测值 [26]；激活能不同的介质会改变每个期限及其强制产生的刷新流量，因此每次运行报告激活能扫描，而非一个单一寿命。

units.en: 9 Conclusion
units.zh: 9 结论

units.en: HBFSim is the first open-source HBF simulator with the workload under evaluation executing on a real GPU. HBF-Sim rewrites the workload’s PTX, routes accesses inside a registered address range into the simulator, and supports asynchronous TMA transfers and capacities beyond physical GPU memory. The modeled wait falls at the instruction that reads the returned value, not at the point of issue. The timing model is calibrated from measurements on real hardware rather than parameter-sheet values. A coupled thermal module puts HBF, HBM, and the GPU in one package, so junction temperature changes the service rate and the refresh traffic that the retention deadline forces. HBFSim leaves the model’s run unaffected across ordinary-memory, TMA, and capacity-mode tests. The delay HBFSim injects matches the delay requested to within 0.152%. A run whose addresses span 110 GiB through a 2 GiB page cache returns a checksum identical to a native run’s. Over horizons of 600, 3,600 and 86,400 s, five control policies sustain the full 384.0 GB/s without throttling. Within that envelope the modeled package reaches its thermal limit at the compute die, at 86.6 W, not at HBF. Under one package-area budget, installed capacity rises from 216 GiB in an all-HBM layout to 1,572 GiB in the most HBF-heavy one while the key-value state HBM can hold falls. In a captured Qwen3-30B routing trace, deduplicated expert demand grows to 2.487 and 3.584 times batch one at batches 8 and 16, while routing decisions grow linearly. Before HBF parts sample, HBFSim lets someone designing an inference system measure a capacity or placement decision under a real workload instead of assuming one.
units.zh: HBFSim 是首款让被评估工作负载在真实 GPU 上执行的开源 HBF 模拟器。HBFSim 重写工作负载的 PTX，将已注册地址范围内的访问路由至模拟器，并支持异步 TMA 传输以及超出 GPU 物理内存的容量。建模等待发生在读取返回数值的指令处，而非发射点。时序模型根据真实硬件测量校准，而非采用参数表数值。耦合热模块将 HBF、HBM 和 GPU 放在同一封装中，使结温改变服务速率，以及数据保持期限所强制产生的刷新流量。在普通内存、TMA 和容量模式测试中，HBFSim 均未改变模型的运行结果。HBFSim 注入的延迟与请求延迟之间的误差不超过 0.152%。一次通过 2 GiB 页缓存访问跨度 110 GiB 地址的运行，返回与原生运行相同的校验和。在 600、3,600 和 86,400 s 时间跨度内，五种控制策略均在不节流的情况下维持完整的 384.0 GB/s。在该范围内，建模封装首先在计算裸片处达到热极限，对应 86.6 W，而非在 HBF 处。在同一封装面积预算下，安装容量从全 HBM 布局的 216 GiB 升至 HBF 占比最高布局的 1,572 GiB，同时 HBM 可容纳的键值状态减少。在捕获的 Qwen3-30B 路由轨迹中，批量大小为 8 和 16 时，去重专家需求分别增至批量 1 的 2.487 倍和 3.584 倍，而路由决策数线性增长。在 HBF 样片问世之前，HBFSim 使推理系统设计者能够在真实工作负载下测量容量或放置决策的影响，而无须仅凭假设。
